probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently Amended) A dynamic laminar structure, for example for working tools and machines, comprising a lamination of at least two layers and an internal layer wherein the internal layer is a combination of two or more components, the structure further comprising: a first layer; a second layer; __a first adhesive layer positioned between the first layer and the internal layer__; __a second adhesive layer positioned between the second layer and the internal layer__; the first layer and the second layer __positioned on opposite sides of the internal layer__; a medial section comprising the internal layer; and a plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments having an inner arc shape and an outer arc shape, wherein the inner arc shape of each of the arc-shaped cutting segments is directly affixed to an outer perimeter of the first and second layers.

2. (Currently Amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 281, wherein the medial section comprises a metal.

3. (Currently Amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 282, wherein the metal is a honeycomb structure.

4. (Currently Amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 282, wherein the medial section is a composite material.

5. (Currently Amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 281, further comprising a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers.

6. (Currently Amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 285, wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section.

7. (Currently Amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 285, wherein the plurality of cutting segments are also welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring.

8. (Currently Amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 285, wherein the weld ring is continuous.

9. (Currently Amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 285, further comprising __a segmented weld ring__ wherein the weld ring is segmented into a plurality of segments.

10. (Currently Amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 285, further comprising an inner ring, wherein the medial section is coupled on an inner perimeter to the inner ring.

11. (Currently Amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 290, wherein the inner ring includes __a__ central opening for accommodating a drive shaft.

12. (Currently Amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 281, further comprising a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of cutting segments, such that the plurality of cutting segments are located on an outer periphery of the weld ring.

13. (Currently Amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 293, wherein the weld ring is continuous.
